orchestrator_output.text_narration: The Indian Premier League, or IPL, is one of the biggest cricket tournaments in the world. Besides exciting cricket, it is also a huge business driven by smart strategies and teamwork. IPL makes money through four main sources. First, TV and online streaming channels pay huge fees called media rights to show the matches live. Second, major brands pay money to sponsor the tournament and place logos on players' jerseys. Third, stadium ticket sales bring revenue every time fans buy tickets to watch live matches in stadiums. Fourth, selling official team jerseys, caps, and souvenirs adds to their earnings. All these income sources are split between the league and the team owners. We can learn three important strategic lessons from IPL. First, innovation by combining sports with entertainment makes learning or business exciting. Second, power of team spirit by bringing top global talent together to achieve success. Third, consistent planning and discipline lead to long-term growth.
